S1.title: Supplementary Table S1. Cell selection.

sheets.description: The selection rule (no supertype other than PVM_3 and PVM_4 with more than 1% of its own cells selected) at 101 cutoffs from 1.0% to 6.0%, applied to all supertypes (pass_raw) and after excluding supertypes with fewer than 100 cells (pass_guarded) (Supplementary Figure S1A).
Fold enrichment of held-out Mic.13 markers, scoring-panel markers and homeostatic markers at each cutoff, for all cells kept (cum) and for the cells added within a 0.25 percentage-point band (marg).

Gaussian mixture fits to each base score: BIC with one and two components, the number of components (one to three) with the lowest BIC (best_k), and the two-component fit compared with a unimodal null.
Reproducibility of the selected cells over 200 donor bootstrap resamples at each cutoff.
The three ways of matching the two region sets (equal percentage, equal number of cells or equal purity); equal percentage was used.
Overlap of the M4 selection with its two parent scores, M1 and M2.
Composition of the M4-selected cells at the 3.0% cutoff by supertype, with enrichment and donor-bootstrap 95% CIs (Figure 1A and B).
Composition by supertype of the top 3.0% under each of the six candidate scorers.
Comparison of the six candidate scorers.
Number of selected cells, composition and selection-rule verdict at the cutoffs of 2.5%, 2.9%, 3.0%, 3.1% and 5%.

S2.title: Supplementary Table S2. Mic.13 validation.
S2.subtitle: Differential expression of M4-selected against non-selected PVM_3 cells and recovery of the Mic.13 markers not used for scoring, in each region set. The column arm gives the region set (NeoC or NonNeoC).

sheets.description: Differential expression of M4-selected against non-selected PVM_3 cells per region and for the pooled PVM_2_3 and PVM_4 contrasts: cells per group and significant genes (adjusted p <0.05, absolute log2 fold change ≥0.25 and expression in ≥15% of selected cells).

Hypergeometric recovery of Mic.13 markers among the significant genes, for the 68 markers not in the scoring panel, the 27 markers in the scoring panel (IN-SCORER) and the 12 DAM2 genes not in the scoring panel. The tests against UP DEGs count only the genes higher in the selected cells.
Each Mic.13 marker gene: expression in the reference Mic.13 population, whether it is in the scoring panel, its differential-expression result and the number of regions in which it was significant.
